accounting: Integer nanodollars; persist before dispatch; no refunds; missing usage retains full reservation
billing_limit: Byte-based admission estimate is not certified tokenizer/billing data; no account-wide or invoice guarantee
request_slots: 1 triage + up to 4*(planning + assessment) + 1 root cause + 1 remediation proposal
mcp_calls: 1 bootstrap incident read + up to 4 model-selected read-only diagnostics
stop: Any non-200 response, invalid/incomplete output/citations, transport error, quota/access denial, budget/deadline, ledger failure
success: Supported final diagnosis: existing gates, evidence review and private grader pass
Correct evidence-based abstention: explicit model abstain, no failure, no proposal, independent review confirms genuinely insufficient/contradictory evidence
not_success: Incomplete, budget exhaustion, transport/HTTP/schema/citation failure; safe abstention on sufficient answerable evidence is not successful diagnosis
outputs: Plan, pre-dispatch ledger, validated decisions, final state/evidence, private grade, fixture/effect checks, review-required outcome
